EmailTemplate.subject: There’s Power in Giving! - Be a Part of Saving Lives!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <name>,
Our upcoming blood drive is <date/time> at <location> and we need you to be a part of this lifesaving event!
Join us as we embark on a mission that can make an immense difference in the lives of countless individuals.
I am also pleased to share that the Red Cross expanded its testing to include sickle cell trait screening on all donations from self-identified African American, Black, and multiracial donors. This screening will help the Red Cross identify compatible blood types more quickly to help sickle cell patients and provide an additional health insight for donors.
In the U.S., it is estimated that over 100,000 people have sickle cell disease — most who are of African descent and will require regular blood transfusions to help manage their disease.
Here’s how you can help:
Sign up to donate at RedCrossClood.org using sponsor code <code>, or via the Red Cross Blood Donor App, or by replying to me. Complete your health questionnaire via RapidPass® and save time on the day of the blood drive. Review the Sickle Cell Trait Screening FAQs and visit RedCrossBlood.org/SCTrait to learn more. Spread the word and bring friends, family and colleagues to donate.
Here's what you need to know about the sickle cell trait screening:
Blood transfusion is an essential treatment for those with sickle cell disease, and blood donations from individuals of the same ethnicity and blood type have a unique ability to help patients fighting sickle cell disease.
The blood donation process will not change — donations will be screened using samples obtained at the time of donation. There will be no charge to donors. Due to the anticipated high demand, appointments are highly encouraged. Donors can expect to receive results to their screenings within one to two weeks through our Red Cross Blood Donor App and the online donor portal at RedCrossBlood.org. Donors need to have a successful donation to receive the screening results.
Let’s come together and show the true power of giving! If you have any questions, please contact me, a Red Cross representative at 1-800-RED CROSS, or visit RedCrossBlood.org.
Sincerely,
<Name>
